scope: Integrated local application: 20 unseen read-speech recordings and 10 fixed noise/compression trials
native_configuration: Portable CPU, dynamic backends, all CPU variants, OpenMP off

plan.selection: Next five distinct eligible sentence IDs per language after the model-selection sample; original TSV order, 5-25 seconds, independent English reference
plan.pipeline_plan: First two selected recordings per language through the frozen app, with automatic detection except explicit Hindi/Urdu script choices; remaining three reserved for follow-up failures. Evaluate both original and English output, failures, timestamps and provenance.
plan.stress_plan: First held-out recording per language, prefixed by 1.25 seconds silence and mixed with deterministic pink noise at amplitude 0.015, encoded to AAC at 32 kb/s. Keep the 1.25-second reference offset. Separate negative silence, tone, real aircraft and music tests; no geolocation accuracy claim.
